entry_points.text: Workers invoke callback with work item; mqueue mounts with restricted flags and sticky root; open creates or opens, unlink pins inode.
Timed send and receive accept optional absolute deadline with 32-bit translation; notify arms modes or disarms; attr toggles nonblock only.
SysV msg, sem and shm native, legacy and compat calls forward to shared helpers for get, control, send, receive, ops, attach and multiplex.

exports.text: Provide normal, ordered and legacy workqueue creation; ordered means unbound with single concurrency.
Submit, schedule, delay, modify and conditionally queue work; flush queues, run on CPU, convert containers.
Translate ids across user namespaces, test group membership, check capabilities, charge rlimit counters.
Create, insert and order POSIX mqueue messages; allocate chained SysV messages and resolve queue ids.
Account pending signals, manage jobctl pending and trapping, acquire sighand, classify payload layout.
Set up and tear down IPC namespaces and SysV tables; acquire sem sets, manage shm attach, undo and exit.

hazards.text: Flushing system queues can stall or deadlock and warns; misaligned or oversized pool corrupts flags; concurrency and color bounds apply.
Mq and SysV report distinct errors and revalidate vanished queues; mqueue magic 0x19800202 anchors format.
Queueing alloc failure coalesces or drops origin detail; ucount overflow and underflow warn; traced fatal withheld except kill; reuse revalidated.
Publish only fully initialized objects with teardown on failure; wakeups deferred past unlock; attach checks wrap; sigstack 1 on-stack 2 disabled.

invariants.text: Work state packs flags, color cycle and aligned pool or disable word; sixteen colors; atomic tests only.
Work init records empty linkage and callback; delayed arms timer variants; pending and static are bit tests.
Sysctl vectors bound output, reject bad numbers and warn on ignored writes; IPC perms shift by ownership; sem fourth bounded.
Group signals share pending while private use task pending; standard coalesce; ignore honors traced, init and exiting; wake needs eligible thread.
Upward and downward id lookup requires full containment in one extent; misses yield sentinel mapped to overflow.
Mq checks prio, length and access with sleep or nonblock fail and direct handoff; SysV ids split index and sequence with liveness check.
New SysV objects start zeroed with defaults and capacity checks; stat enforces perms and liveness; updates stamp and re-evaluate waiters.
Namespace creation charges quota with unwind and needs caps in both namespaces; without SysV, setup and teardown are successful no-ops.

locks.text: Per-queue spin guards mqueue tree, counters, waiters and notify; readiness published under lock with wakeups after unlock; unlink uses write protection.
Sighand mutex guards signal queue mutation, flush and trap checks; IRQ-safe acquire revalidates; RCU covers creds and ucounts; barriers order extents.
SysV object spin plus RCU guards alloc and lookup; set guards nest outside object; sem uses member or forced global mode; shm revalidates under lock.
Workqueue flush maps under read guard then pool lock; barrier insert assumes pool lock; task lock samples namespaces; proc holds object across show.

state_machines.text: Mqueue waiters enrol by direction and prio; sleeper releases lock for timed wait and reports ready, interrupt or expiry with removal.
Mq open resolves, creates or opens with perms and audit then instantiates; send and receive use direct handoff or queued insert with notify.
Jobctl cycles pending, consumed and dequeued with trapping wakeup; stop and continue purge each other; generation reports ignored, queued, overflow or loss.
SysV senders sleep interruptible and wake by fit scan; sem ops are all-or-nothing with undo; complex mode splices queues; shm open and close gate destroy; flush uses barrier.

structs.text: Work unit holds atomic state, linkage and callback; delayed adds timer and placement; attrs hold nice, CPUs, scope and ordering.
Mqueue inode holds spin, waits, priority tree, attrs and notify; waiter holds task and ready state; tree node holds list and prio.
SysV msg queue holds perm, usage, capacity, stamps and lists; waiter holds task and size; sem set holds members, queues, undo and links.
Shm segment holds perm, file, size, attach count, times and flags; compat SysV status uses narrowed widths for perms, times and counts.
